title: Rooms Keys List — payload
description: List the rooms the key holder can open for members the caller may act as. `includePersonal` asks for each entry's personal label as well; absent, none is returned. Carries no filter: the recipient answers for the members its caller acts as, and there is nothing to ask it about. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

includePersonal.description: `true` asks for each entry's personal label (rooms/keys/label) in `personal`. Absent or `false`: no entry carries one. A request option, not a filter — it changes which members of an entry are returned, never which entries — and off by default so that a caller that has no use for the member's own names, or will pass the list on, never receives them.

Response.title: Rooms Keys List — response payload
Response.description: Success response to rooms/keys/list. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/rooms/keys/list/0.2#response. The rooms this key holder can open, one entry per room and member, for the members the caller may act as. This is key custody, not membership: a room whose group state was never delivered is absent here and the member may still hold a perfectly good VMC for it.

rooms.description: One entry per room and member, in no guaranteed order. A room held as two members the caller may act as appears twice, once per member.

member.description: The member this entry's group state is held for: the DID the room admitted. What a client names as `member` to rooms/keys/label, and as `issuer` to rooms/keys/act, to act on this entry rather than on the same room held as another member.

epoch.description: The epoch this key holder is at for this member. Behind the room's own epoch means a commit has not been delivered, and records sealed since will not open.

earliestReadableEpoch.description: The earliest epoch this key holder can derive a key for, for this member, walking the epoch key chain it holds. Equal to `epoch` means it reads only from where it joined; `1` means the room's whole retained history. Anything between is a chain that has been delivered in part, or one deliberately severed below that point.

personal.description: The member's own label for the room (rooms/keys/label). Present only when the request set `includePersonal: true` and the member has one. Private to the member: a caller MUST NOT pass it to the room's host, its owner, a community or a website the member has not chosen to show it to.
